headline: Mandatory pre-application meeting for organizations seeking CDBG funding.
summary: The Housing and Community Development Division will review program eligibility, reporting requirements, and the new online application software for prospective CDBG applicants. Attendance is required for any organization that intends to apply for funding.
plain_text:
City of Portland 
Mandatory CDBG Applicant Meeting 
 
 
 
 Thursday, October 15, 2026 at 9:30 AM  
 
Join us for a mandatory pre-application meeting for 
prospective applicants on Thursday, October 15th at 9:30am 
via Zoom. If you intend to apply for funding or want to learn 
more about the program, your organization's attendance is 
required in order to review the program eligibility, reporting 
requirements, and the new online application software. 
 
The Housing and Community Development Division will 
conduct this meeting remotely via Zoom pursuant to the 
Remote Meeting Policy. Allow your computer to install the 
free Zoom app to get the best meeting experience. If you are 
not able to attend live either in person or via Zoom, a 
recording will be available in the Agenda Center following the 
meeting. 
  
For public comment via Zoom, you will need to use the "raise 
your hand" feature. To raise your hand via the telephone, 
please hit *9. You will be unmuted by the host when it is time 
for public comment. 
When: Oct 15, 2026 09:30 AM Eastern Time (US and 
Canada) 
Topic:  Mandatory CDBG Applicant Meeting 
 
YOU MUST register in advance for this webinar: 
https://portlandmaine-
gov.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_XWdv6b-
STpuaVREZFVt-aQ 
 
After registering, you will receive a confirmation email 
containing information about joining the webinar.
